title: Arizona Revised Statutes, Title 43 - Taxation of Income
source_id: A.R.S. tit. 43 (withholding at ss 43-401 to 43-435; individuals at ss 43-1001 to 43-1099)
verified_how: Fetched the Title 43 index: 'Chapter 4: WITHHOLDING (Sections 43-401 to 43-435)' with Article 1 Withholding by Employer, Article 2 Rights and Duties of Employers, Article 3 Withholding as Payment of Tax for Employee; and 'Chapter 10: INDIVIDUALS (Sections 43-1001 to 43-1099)' with Articles 1-6 (Definitions; Tax Rates and Tables; Adjustments to Arizona Gross Income; Deductions; Credits; Nonresidents). Compilation updated through the 57th Legislature, 2nd Regular Session.
notes: Title 43 as a whole is the income tax code; the two chapters named are the ones that bear on individuals and payroll withholding.
